description: iPhone face-up, charge-port edge toward laptop hinge, ~2.5 in from phone bottom edge to MacBook screen, resting on ~0.5 in soft cloth, far-left palm rest
note: Same geometry used for the Pixel 7a throughout. Phone bottom edge (mics/speaker) faces the Mac speakers.
coupling: air-coupled (NOT structure-borne): phone rests on ~0.5 in soft cloth throughout, which damps chassis vibration conduction. This addresses the 'partly structure-coupled?' concern -- the link is genuinely over-the-air.
contrast: contact_palmrest (36.6 kbps, ~1.5 ms delay spread near-field pocket) vs desk_air_offset (0 kbps, 35.8 ms delay spread; laptop elevated 5in on stand over hard desk = reverberant cavity). Both cloth-isolated, so the difference is the ACOUSTIC ENVIRONMENT (proximity + reverb), not structure vs air coupling.
